strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈,来看这边。
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}, look over here.

strings.zh: 水晶『那边就是被寄养的精灵,{NEWLINE}爷爷奶奶特意做了这个场地{CLEAR}好让精灵们在上面玩耍休息。{SCROLL}水晶『我小时候经常跟{NEWLINE}被寄养的精灵们在这玩,{CLEAR}还在精灵们休息的草垫子上睡午觉,{CLEAR}那个垫子可舒服了！
strings.en: Crystal: Those are the Pokémon{NEWLINE}being looked after here. Grandpa{CLEAR}and Grandma made this area{CLEAR}specially so they can play and rest.{SCROLL}Crystal: When I was little, I used{NEWLINE}to play here with the Pokémon{CLEAR}all the time. I even took naps{CLEAR}on the grass mat where they{CLEAR}rest. That mat is super comfy!

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈如果也想寄养精灵,{NEWLINE}就来这边。
strings.en: Crystal: If you want to leave some{NEWLINE}Pokémon here too, come this way.

strings.zh: 水晶『奶奶,你瞧我把谁带来了？
strings.en: Crystal: Grandma, look who I brought!

strings.zh: 咦？水晶,你除了阿金{NEWLINE}还有别的男朋友吗？
strings.en: Huh? Crystal, you have another{NEWLINE}boyfriend besides Gold?
strings.notes: Gender branch: #4 male player (‘another boyfriend’) / #5 female player (‘Gold in a dress’); Crystal replies #6 / #7. #9 is the female-player line.

strings.zh: 这为小姐该不会是……{NEWLINE}换上女装的阿金吧？
strings.en: This young lady couldn’t be...{NEWLINE}Gold in a dress, could she?

strings.zh: 水晶『你说什么呢奶奶！{NEWLINE}我跟阿金还有{VAR:0103:0}前辈{CLEAR}不是那种关系啦！
strings.en: Crystal: What are you saying,{NEWLINE}Grandma?! Gold and {VAR:0103:0}{CLEAR}and I aren’t like that!

strings.zh: 水晶『你说什么呢奶奶！{NEWLINE}不要总是往阿金身上靠啊！
strings.en: Crystal: What are you{NEWLINE}saying, Grandma?! Stop{CLEAR}always pairing me with Gold!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}？{NEWLINE}莫非这位是……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}? Could this be...

strings.zh: 哈哈,奶奶开玩笑的。{NEWLINE}我只是觉得这位小姐面熟……
strings.en: Ha ha, Grandma’s only{NEWLINE}joking. I just thought this{CLEAR}young lady looked familiar...

strings.zh: 啊！你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}我和老伴在电视上看过你！{CLEAR}难怪觉得这么面熟呢。
strings.en: Oh! You’re League Champion {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}My husband and I saw you on TV!{CLEAR}No wonder you looked so familiar.

strings.zh: 水晶『嘿嘿,{VAR:0103:0}前辈也是{NEWLINE}我在旅行中的伙伴哦。{CLEAR}从他那里我学了很多东西呢。
strings.en: Crystal: Heh heh, {VAR:0103:0} is one of my{NEWLINE}traveling companions too. I’ve learned{CLEAR}so much from them.
strings.notes: zh 从他那里 (male pronoun); English repeats the name to stay gender-neutral. | RV034: omission: 从他那里 (from the player) restored, gender-neutral per D-1224 (D-1811)

strings.zh: 我知道,我知道。{NEWLINE}能跟世上最强的训练家一起旅行,{CLEAR}我孙女还真是幸运啊。
strings.en: I know, I know. Getting to travel with{NEWLINE}the strongest Trainer in the world...{CLEAR}My granddaughter sure is lucky.

strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈,{NEWLINE}我爷爷奶奶很会照顾精灵的,{CLEAR}你如果把精灵交给他们寄养,{CLEAR}不光精灵的等级会提高,{CLEAR}有时候还会得到精灵的蛋呢。{SCROLL}水晶『强烈推荐你把精灵{NEWLINE}寄养在这里试试哦。
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}, my grandpa and{NEWLINE}grandma are really good at taking{CLEAR}care of Pokémon. If you leave{CLEAR}your Pokémon with them, not only{CLEAR}will their levels go up, sometimes{CLEAR}you’ll even get a Pokémon Egg!{SCROLL}Crystal: I really recommend{NEWLINE}leaving some Pokémon here!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好,我会试试的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Okay, I’ll give it a try.

strings.zh: 水晶『奶奶,我要去满金市了。{NEWLINE}你和爷爷要保重好身体,{CLEAR}等我在城都地区旅行完了,{CLEAR}再来看你们哦！
strings.en: Crystal: Grandma, I’m off to Goldenrod{NEWLINE}City. You and Grandpa take care of{CLEAR}yourselves. When I’m done traveling{CLEAR}around Johto, I’ll come see you again!

strings.zh: 嗯,水晶你从小自理能力就很强,{NEWLINE}奶奶相信你没问题的。
strings.en: Mm-hmm. Crystal, you’ve been able to{NEWLINE}look after yourself ever since you were{CLEAR}little. Grandma knows you’ll be fine.

strings.zh: 水晶『那拜拜咯,奶奶！
strings.en: Crystal: Bye-bye, Grandma!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哇,还能得到蛋？{NEWLINE}那我可得试试。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Whoa, you can even get{NEWLINE}Eggs? Then I’ve got to try it.

strings.zh: 阿响『奶奶！{SCROLL}因为都是精灵训练师{NEWLINE}所以才记电话的,{CLEAR}不要乱说哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ethan: Grandma!{SCROLL}We only exchanged numbers because{NEWLINE}we’re both Pokémon Trainers.{CLEAR}Don’t get the wrong idea!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0385/19; US line (vanilla Ethan) rewritten from the hack's zh.
